sentences.en: Comedian Brand faces a "significant" prison sentence, which a London court judge is set to hand down on Monday.
sentences.zh: 喜剧演员布兰德面临“重大”监禁判决，伦敦法院法官将于周一作出判决。

items.title: Homes and temples glow across India to mark Diwali

sentences.en: Homes and temples glow across India to mark Diwali.
sentences.zh: 房屋和寺庙遍布印度各地，以纪念排灯节。

sentences.en: Millions of Indians are marking the festival of lights with glowing lamps, fireworks and traditional sweets.
sentences.zh: 数以百万计的印度人正在用发光的灯、烟花和传统糖果来庆祝这个节日。

items.title: Israel’s president picks Yashar leader Gadi Eisenkot to form government

sentences.en: Israel’s president picks Yashar leader Gadi Eisenkot to form government.
sentences.zh: 以色列总统选举亚沙尔领导人加迪·艾森科特组建政府。

sentences.en: Knesset has been deadlocked since the election last month when Benjamin Netanyahu’s coalition lost its majority Israel’s president has ⁠chosen Gadi Eisenkot, the prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s ⁠strongest rival, to ⁠try to ​form a new government, after a deadlocked election that left neither man ⁠with a clear path to power.
sentences.zh: 以色列议会自上个月大选以来一直陷入僵局，当时本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（ Benjamin Netanyahu ）的联盟失去了多数席位，以色列总统选择了总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（ Benjamin Netanyahu ）最强大的竞争对手加迪·艾森科特（ Gadi Eisenkot ）试图组建新政府，此前大选陷入僵局，两人都没有明确的权力之路。

sentences.en: Isaac Herzog’s office said he had informed Eisenkot, the leader of the Yashar party, on Saturday night “of his intention to task him with forming a government”.
sentences.zh: 艾萨克·赫尔佐格（ Isaac Herzog ）的办公室表示，他已于周六晚上通知亚沙尔党领袖艾森科特（ Eisenkot ） ， “他打算委托他组建政府”。

items.title: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests

sentences.en: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests.
sentences.zh: 1月抗议活动后，伊朗处决了三名“武装骚乱”男子。

sentences.en: It is claimed Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were part of anti-government protests earlier this year.
sentences.zh: 据称，哈桑·迪奥班德（ Hassan Dioband ）、哈米德·卡泽米（ Hamid Kazemi ）和雷扎·赞加内（ Reza Zanganeh ）今年早些时

items.title: SS United States, a historic ship will be sunk to create an artificial reef

sentences.en: SS United States, a historic ship will be sunk to create an artificial reef.
sentences.zh: SS United States ，一艘历史悠久的船只将被击沉，以创建一个人造礁石。

sentences.en: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to Alex Fogg, Natural Resources Chief of Okaloosa County, Florida, about efforts to deliberately sink the SS United States and create an artificial reef in its wreckage.
sentences.zh: NPR的阿耶莎·拉斯科（ Ayesha Rascoe ）与佛罗里达州奥卡卢萨县（ Okaloosa County ）自然资源主管亚历克斯·福格（ Alex Fogg ）谈论了故意击沉SS美国并在其残骸中创建人工珊瑚礁的努力。

items.title: UK spent £100m on zombie Brexit border inspection posts

sentences.en: UK spent £100m on zombie Brexit border inspection posts.
sentences.zh: 英国在僵尸英国退欧边境检查站上花费了1亿美元£。

sentences.en: Five of seven facilities in England and Wales never reached operational stage as Tories vacillated over plans to check goods The UK wasted at least £100m in taxpayers’ money to set up zombie Brexit border inspection posts that were never used, it has been revealed.
sentences.zh: 据透露，英格兰和威尔士的七个设施中有五个从未达到运营阶段，因为保守党对检查货物的计划犹豫不决英国浪费了至少1亿英镑的纳税人资金来建立从未使用过的僵尸英国退欧边境检查站。

sentences.en: The overall cost of Brexit was put at an estimated £4.7bn by the National Audit Office last year but this included years-long transformation of the software used for customs declarations and other systems built to cope with the UK leaving the single market.
sentences.zh: 英国国家审计署去年估计英国脱欧的总成本为47亿英镑，但这包括用于海关申报的软件和其他为应对英国退出单一市场而构建的系统的长达数年的改造。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: How African philosophies inspired a new approach to staging film festivals in Manchester

sentences.en: How African philosophies inspired a new approach to staging film festivals in Manchester.
sentences.zh: 非洲哲学如何激发了在曼彻斯特举办电影节的新方法。

sentences.en: See My World, an event highlighting the pan-African thought via film, poetry and dance, builds on momentum sparked by local activists and creatives African philosophies including exploring how lessons from the past can shape the present and near future have inspired a film festival coming to Manchester.
sentences.zh: See My World是一项通过电影、诗歌和舞蹈突出泛非思想的活动，以当地活动家和创意非洲哲学引发的动力为基础，包括探索过去的经验教训如何塑造现在和不久的将来，激发了一个电影节来到曼彻斯特。

sentences.en: See My World , a day dedicated to independent creators from across the African diaspora in the north of England, will take place at the Contact theatre on 21 November.
sentences.zh: See My World将于11月21日在Contact剧院举行，为来自英格兰北部非洲移民社群的独立创作者举办纪念活动。

sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Beyond the broken glass: The human cost of the 1938 November Pogrom

sentences.en: Beyond the broken glass: The human cost of the 1938 November Pogrom.
sentences.zh: 超越破碎的玻璃： 1938年11月大屠杀的人力成本。

sentences.en: On his way to school in Vienna on the morning of 10 November 1938, eight-year-old Arthur Schneier watched his synagogue burn while firefighters and police officers stood by “rejoicing”.
sentences.zh: 1938年11月10日上午，在维也纳上学的路上， 8岁的亚瑟·施奈尔（ Arthur Schneier ）看着他的犹太教堂燃烧，而消防员和警察则站在“欢乐”旁边。

items.title: Polish prosecutors open terrorism investigation into Kraków shooting

sentences.en: Polish prosecutors open terrorism investigation into Kraków shooting.
sentences.zh: 波兰检察官对克拉科夫枪击事件展开恐怖主义调查。

sentences.en: Six people killed in attack probably inspired by far right, according to officials, as police say suspect’s parents and sister found dead at his home Polish prosecutors have opened a terrorism investigation after a 24-year-old man opened fire in a busy market square in Kraków, killing six people including a Briton and injuring 17, in an attack that authorities said was probably inspired by far-right ideologies.
sentences.zh: 根据官员的说法，六人在袭击中丧生可能是受到极右翼的启发，因为警方称嫌疑人的父母和姐姐在他的家中被发现死亡波兰检察官在一名24岁的男子在克拉科夫一个繁忙的市场广场开火后展开了恐怖主义调查，造成六人死亡，其中包括一名英国人， 17人受伤，当局称这次袭击可能是受到极右翼意识形态的启发。

sentences.en: Police confirmed on Sunday that three people found dead at the gunman’s home after the attack on Saturday afternoon were his father, 53, mother, 52, and sister, 21.
sentences.zh: 警方周日证实，在星期六下午的袭击事件后，在枪手家中发现了三名死者，分别是他的父亲53岁、母亲52岁和姐姐21岁。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: A desert stirs to life: Chile's Atacama erupts in its biggest floral display in decades

sentences.en: A desert stirs to life: Chile's Atacama erupts in its biggest floral display in decades.
sentences.zh: 一片生机勃勃的沙漠：智利的阿塔卡马在几十年来最大的花卉展览中爆发。

sentences.en: El Niño rains have transformed Chile's Atacama Desert into a spectacular sea of color, awakening a fleeting ecosystem of flowers and wildlife in one of the driest places on Earth.
sentences.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象将智利的阿塔卡马沙漠变成了一片壮观的色彩之海，唤醒了地球上最干燥的地方之一短暂的花卉和野生动物生态系统。

sentences.en: (Image credit: Tamara Merino for NPR)

items.title: One air ambulance service rethinks what it takes to practice medicine in the sky

sentences.en: One air ambulance service rethinks what it takes to practice medicine in the sky.
sentences.zh: 一家空中救护车服务公司重新考虑在空中行医所需的条件。

sentences.en: Air medical service comes with high risks, high costs, and staffing struggles.
sentences.zh: 空中医疗服务伴随着高风险、高成本和人员配备的困难。

sentences.en: To reduce turnover and serve rural patients, LifeFlight of Maine is putting the needs of healthcare workers first.
sentences.zh: 为了减少人员流动并为农村患者提供服务， LifeFlight of Maine将医护人员的需求放在首位。

sentences.en: Climate change is altering the colors we see in the world: an illustrated journey.
sentences.zh: 气候变化正在改变我们在世界上看到的颜色：一段插图般的旅程。

items.title: Pope’s visit to Argentina sets up showdown with ‘hyper-capitalist’ Milei

sentences.en: Pope’s visit to Argentina sets up showdown with ‘hyper-capitalist’ Milei.
sentences.zh: 教皇对阿根廷的访问引发了与“超级资本主义” Milei的摊牌。

sentences.en: President has opposing views on many issues, and once called Leo’s predecessor the ‘representative of the Evil One’ Trees are being planted in the garden.
sentences.zh: 总统在许多问题上持反对意见，曾经称狮子的前任为“邪恶者的代表”的树木被种植在花园里。

sentences.en: The brightly coloured buildings are getting another coat of paint.
sentences.zh: 色彩鲜艳的建筑物正在涂上另一层油漆。

sentences.en: The choir rehearses.
sentences.zh: 合唱团排练。

sentences.en: Hundreds of other residents, several of them using wheelchairs, practise their positions outside the sanctuary.
sentences.zh: 数百名其他居民，其中一些使用轮椅，在避难所外练习他们的姿势。

sentences.en: Excitement is in the air, because on Monday 9 November, the Cottolengo Don Orione – a Catholic-run home for disabled people – will be the first stop on Pope Leo XIV’s first full day of his trip to Argentina.
sentences.zh: 令人兴奋的是， 11月9日星期一，天主教徒经营的残疾人之家Cottolengo Don Orione将成为教皇利奥十四世访问阿根廷的第一天的第一站。

sentences.en: But the pope’s visit to Claypole, about 26km from Buenos Aires, does not come at an especially happy time for the home, which counts about 400 residents with disabilities.
sentences.zh: 但是，教皇对距离布宜诺斯艾利斯约26公里的克莱波尔的访问并不是在这个拥有约400名残疾居民的家庭特别开心的时候进行的。

sentences.en: Argentina’s president, Javier Milei, has made wide-ranging cuts to disability funding.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱（ Javier Milei ）已大幅削减残疾基金。

items.title: Banana producers in Latin America want better pay to cope with effects of climate crisis

sentences.en: Banana producers in Latin America want better pay to cope with effects of climate crisis.
sentences.zh: 拉丁美洲的香蕉生产商希望获得更高的薪酬，以应对气候危机的影响。

sentences.en: Farmers face big drop in production from extreme weather during this year’s super El Niño event Banana producers in Latin America are calling for better pay to help cope with the impact of the climate crisis, as they face big drops in production resulting from extreme weather during this year’s super El Niño event.
sentences.zh: 农民在今年的超级厄尔尼诺现象期间面临极端天气导致的产量大幅下降拉丁美洲的香蕉生产商呼吁提高工资，以帮助应对气候危机的影响，因为他们在今年的超级厄尔尼诺现象期间面临极端天气导致的产量大幅下降。

sentences.en: High winds in parts of Colombia, one of the biggest suppliers to the UK market where droughts are predicted in some regions this year, and heavy rainfall in Peru and Ecuador are already affecting production, according to the Fairtrade Foundation ethical trade body.
sentences.zh: 根据公平贸易基金会道德贸易机构的数据，哥伦比亚部分地区的大风，以及秘鲁和厄瓜多尔的强降雨已经影响了生产。哥伦比亚是英国市场最大的供应商之一，预计今年一些地区将发生干旱。

sentences.en: In the Dominican Republic, farmers are expected to face drought conditions, with forecasts of drier and warmer than usual conditions.
sentences.zh: 在多米尼加共和国，预计农民将面临干旱状况，预计干旱和温暖状况将比平时更严重。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Uyghurs facing deportation by Thailand say they will be ‘like slaves’ in China

sentences.en: Uyghurs facing deportation by Thailand say they will be ‘like slaves’ in China.
sentences.zh: 面临泰国驱逐的维吾尔人表示，他们在中国将“像奴隶一样”。

sentences.en: Activists fear Bangkok will give in to pressure from Beijing despite reports of torture and human rights abuses against the mostly muslim ethnic minority The deportation of two more Uyghurs to China from Thailand would put their lives in grave danger, activists have said, with one of the men saying he would be “like a slave” if he was sent back.
sentences.zh: 活动人士表示，尽管有报道称大多数穆斯林少数民族遭受酷刑和人权侵犯，但活动人士担心曼谷会屈服于北京的压力。活动人士表示，将另外两名维吾尔人从泰国驱逐到中国将使他们的生命处于严重危险之中，其中一名男子表示，如果他被遣返，他将“像奴隶一样”。

sentences.en: Last year, Thai authorities forcibly deported 40 Uyghur men to China despite pleas from the men themselves and the UN.
sentences.zh: 去年，泰国当局不顾维吾尔人本人和联合国的请求，强行将40名维吾尔人驱逐到中国。

sentences.en: The US and Canada had reportedly offered to resettle them , but Bangkok appeared to want to avoid upsetting Beijing.
sentences.zh: 据报道，美国和加拿大提出重新安置他们，但曼谷似乎希望避免让北京感到不安。

sentences.en: The UN has said the returnees’ whereabouts remain unknown.
sentences.zh: 联合国表示，回归者的下落仍然不明。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: NZ election 2026: New Zealand faces weeks of uncertainty with results ‘too close to call’

sentences.en: NZ election 2026: New Zealand faces weeks of uncertainty with results ‘too close to call’.
sentences.zh: 2026年新西兰大选：新西兰面临数周的不确定性，结果“太接近了”。

sentences.en: National party will be largest in parliament but ultimate shape of next government won’t be settled for some time New Zealand could be facing a weeks-long wait to know the shape of its next government, after its nail-biting election failed to hand a decisive victory to either the incumbent rightwing coalition or opposition left bloc.
sentences.zh: 国民党将在议会中占据最大席位，但下一届政府的最终形态将在一段时间内无法确定新西兰可能面临长达数周的等待，以了解其下一届政府的形态，此前其棘手的选举未能给现任右翼联盟或反对派左翼集团带来决定性的胜利。

sentences.en: On preliminary results, the centre-right National party, led by the prime minister, Christopher Luxon, managed to secure enough seats to govern alongside its traditional coalition partners, the libertarian Act and populist New Zealand First parties.
sentences.zh: 根据初步结果，由总理克里斯托弗·卢克松（ Christopher Luxon ）领导的中右翼国家党（ National party ）设法获得了足够的席位，与其传统的联盟伙伴自由意志主义法案（ Libertarian Act ）和民粹主义的新西兰第一党（ New Zealand First parties ）一起执政。

sentences.en: Continue reading..

items.title: Italian foreign minister says hackers leaked his personal data

sentences.en: Italian foreign minister says hackers leaked his personal data.
sentences.zh: 意大利外交部长表示，黑客泄露了他的个人数据。

sentences.en: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has blamed pro-Russian hackers for publishing the details online.
sentences.zh: 总理乔治亚·梅洛尼（ Giorgia Meloni ）指责亲俄黑客在网上发布详细信息。
